labels.executed_by_candidate: code authored by this candidate and run in the isolated python_execute sandbox; receipts below are copied verbatim from the tool responses
labels.unexecuted: proposed check; labeled UNEXECUTED; no receipt exists

witnesses.name: Coordinate precision, axis-order and unit normalization
witnesses.expected_justification: Python float64 repr-based JSON round-trips exactly for values of this magnitude; IEEE-754 binary32 cannot represent 2**24+1; swapping y/x scales under anisotropic pixels must produce a large, detectable position error; 'px' is absent from the unit table so must be flagged.
witnesses.scope_limits: Pure stdlib arithmetic/serialization in an isolated sandbox. Validates the storage choice (float64, unit table, axis-order test), NOT any shipped reader, viewer, or full application. A first attempt with the same logic (data passed via the harness 'data' parameter) errored with exit 1 (execution receipt in session log) because the parameter arrived as a string; the check was re-run self-contained and is what is receipted here.

witnesses.name: Bounded tile-cache arithmetic for the 3 GB envelope; zarr chunk-key forms
witnesses.expected_justification: For 2048x2048x366 uint16 (~2.86 GiB), 256x256 uint16 tiles give 128 KiB tiles, 64 per plane; 128-tile LRU (16 MiB) plus one displayed plane (8 MiB) is ~24 MiB, far below 16 GiB and ~0.8% of a second full copy.
witnesses.scope_limits: Arithmetic only; ignores decode buffers, GPU textures, interpreter overhead, and 3-D chunk shapes. Which chunk-path form applies (dotted vs nested) is adapter-config dependent and must be verified against real .zarray files (U-3). Does not demonstrate any real reader meeting the envelope.

witnesses.name: Atomic save / interrupted save / failed export recovery (temp + fsync + os.replace)
witnesses.expected_justification: POSIX rename(2) atomically replaces an existing target (man7 S15); writing to a same-directory temp then replacing therefore leaves the prior file intact if the replace never happens, and the temp is recoverable.
witnesses.scope_limits: Single file, local tmpfs/ext-class filesystem, POSIX; does NOT prove crash during rename, multi-file atomicity, or NFS behavior (man7 rename BUGS explicitly cautions on NFS). Component check, not application behavior.

witnesses.name: Embedded-napari 3 GB bounded-access RSS measurement
witnesses.why: requires a desktop/Qt/GPU environment and a real zarr-backed 3 GB volume; sandbox has neither
witnesses.method_if_run: embed napari QtViewer, back a synthetic 2048x2048x366 uint16 volume with zarr, pan through all z while sampling process RSS and GPU-mem if available; assert working set << 1 GiB and no full-array materialization (guard by wrapping the store to fail on full reads)

witnesses.name: Interrupted OME-Zarr write -> recovery scan
witnesses.why: requires zarr library in the execution sandbox
witnesses.method_if_run: kill a chunked write midway; reopen; verify all-or-nothing per chunk, detectable torn group, and recovery to last consistent manifest

witnesses.why: requires the team's real instrument exports
